name: unslop-mobile
description: An agent skill for reviewing and improving mobile interfaces from rendered evidence, with optional capture and before/after video tools. Adapted from unslop by Damir Sokolovsky.

scripts.example: npm run example:capture && npm run example:compare && npm run example:story
scripts.demo:video: node scripts/story.mjs examples/checkout-demo/story.json examples/checkout-demo/media/checkout-demo-portrait.mp4 && node scripts/story.mjs examples/checkout-demo/story.json examples/checkout-demo/media/checkout-demo-square.mp4 --canvas=square && node scripts/story.mjs examples/checkout-demo/story.json examples/checkout-demo/media/checkout-demo-landscape.mp4 --canvas=landscape
